verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs say you can upload photos to get answers, summaries, and insights about them, and on Android you can ask Gemini about what's on your screen, which covers sharing screenshots and photos for interpretation. Hands-on reports on accuracy are mixed: one user found OCR on PDFs about 96% as accurate as a dedicated vendor, but another saw Gemini only partly correct on a doctored image test, and a third got wildly inaccurate bounding boxes. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of image-understanding depth (e.g. screenshot/text reading, charts), consistent independent corroboration of accuracy on photos and screenshots.
